ev.q: Among 13,475 PWH aged ≥50 years who participated in the 2017–2022 MMP cycles
The 2025 goal is 46.2% higher than the 2022 estimate.
Unemployment declined from 11.7% (95% CI = 9.7%–13.6%) in 2017 to 8.0% (95% CI = 6.6%–9.5%) in 2022
Over time, unemployment was lower among those aged ≥65 years than those aged 50–64 years.
The 2025 goal is 26.3% lower than the 2022 estimate.
an annual complex sample survey of U.S. adults with diagnosed HIV
This analysis examined recent trends in QoL indicators among PWH aged ≥50 years
progress toward these goals has not been assessed

methods_quotes.q: Poisson regression models were used to calculate the recent estimated annual percentage change (EAPC) from baseline
Data were weighted for unequal selection probabilities, adjusted for nonresponse, and poststratified to NHSS population totals.
weighted prevalence estimates and 95% CIs were calculated for each QoL indicator and theoretically related factors
The percentage difference between the 2025 NHAS goal and the 2022 estimate, expressed as a percentage of the 2022 estimate, was also calculated
EAPC is a measure of relative change, so its magnitude is affected by the prevalence of the variable assessed.
